decisions.reason: Its sibling injection unit A was already withdrawn and B has not appeared on the website since 2018, but the firm has invested in it, presented it publicly and tied it to its tailored-solutions direction, so management is inclined to persist and attribute weak results to temporary market conditions such as the pandemic.
Although it has not been visible since 2018, the automatic airless gun belongs to the core spray application business, and the sunk development and tooling costs argue for keeping it.
The manual airless gun is a staple complement to the firm's pumps and a public commitment, so the lack of recent visibility is more likely read as temporary than as grounds for withdrawal.

The multi-model air-assisted airless line represents the largest investment and the most visible commitment to the firm's announced core spray technology, so management would persist with it despite uncertain recent evidence.
